criterion: Neutral light strips require 94% coverage/min224/tint30. Warm light frames require 98% coverage/min190/tint60 and at least 3 bounded sides of 2px or more. One measured transition pixel may follow at 75% light coverage. On edges already confirmed as part of a coherent warm frame, trim one further pixel if the median brightness falls by at least 17 and 70% of positions fall by at least 12 in the next row. Each side remains bounded to 3.5%/24px and each dimension retains at least 92%.
